Please correct Screen 1: RAM failure (page 2-2) to read as follows: RAM failure is indicated by a high tone (low tone indicates a good RAM) and, if possible, an A displayed in the top center of the screen. Count the tones. Tone 1 or 2 indicates RAM failure at game PCB location N/P1. Tone three or four indicates RAM failure at game PCB location K7.
